name: עִבְרִי
summary: A Levite of the sons of Merari, named among the sons of Jaaziah in David's ordering of the Levites (1Ch 24:27). The name is spelled as the gentilic עִבְרִי “a Hebrew”; scripture says nothing more of him or of the name.

evidence.note: “The sons of Merari by Jaaziah: Beno, Shoham, Zaccur and Ibri (וְעִבְרִי).”
The word the name is: “Abram the Hebrew (הָעִבְרִי)”.

note: Takes p.ah.ae, one token. That the name is the gentilic “Hebrew” is read from its spelling only.
